findings.text: Entry and execution-policy control identifiers use these encodings: VM_ENTRY_CONTROLS is 0x4012, VM_ENTRY_MSR_LOAD_COUNT is 0x4014, VM_ENTRY_INTR_INFO_FIELD is 0x4016, VM_ENTRY_EXCEPTION_ERROR_CODE is 0x4018, VM_ENTRY_INSTRUCTION_LEN is 0x401a, TPR_THRESHOLD is 0x401c, SECONDARY_VM_EXEC_CONTROL is 0x401e, PLE_GAP is 0x4020, PLE_WINDOW is 0x4022, NOTIFY_WINDOW is 0x4024.

Exit-status identifiers use these encodings: VM_INSTRUCTION_ERROR is 0x4400, VM_EXIT_REASON is 0x4402, VM_EXIT_INTR_INFO is 0x4404, VM_EXIT_INTR_ERROR_CODE is 0x4406, IDT_VECTORING_INFO_FIELD is 0x4408, IDT_VECTORING_ERROR_CODE is 0x440a, VM_EXIT_INSTRUCTION_LEN is 0x440c, VMX_INSTRUCTION_INFO is 0x440e.

Guest segment limit and access-right identifiers plus related guest state use these encodings: ES/CS/SS/DS/FS/GS/LDTR/TR/GDTR/IDTR limits are 0x4800/0x4802/0x4804/0x4806/0x4808/0x480a/0x480c/0x480e/0x4810/0x4812; ES/CS/SS/DS/FS/GS/LDTR/TR access bytes are 0x4814/0x4816/0x4818/0x481a/0x481c/0x481e/0x4820/0x4822; INTERRUPTIBILITY_INFO is 0x4824, ACTIVITY_STATE is 0x4826, SYSENTER_CS is 0x482a, PREEMPTION_TIMER_VALUE is 0x482e; HOST_IA32_SYSENTER_CS is 0x4c00.

Control-register virtualization and exit-detail identifiers use these encodings: CR0_GUEST_HOST_MASK is 0x6000, CR4_GUEST_HOST_MASK is 0x6002, CR0_READ_SHADOW is 0x6004, CR4_READ_SHADOW is 0x6006, CR3_TARGET_VALUE0 through VALUE3 are 0x6008/0x600a/0x600c/0x600e, EXIT_QUALIFICATION is 0x6400, GUEST_LINEAR_ADDRESS is 0x640a.

Wide guest-state identifiers use these encodings: CR0 0x6800, CR3 0x6802, CR4 0x6804, ES_BASE 0x6806, CS_BASE 0x6808, SS_BASE 0x680a, DS_BASE 0x680c, FS_BASE 0x680e, GS_BASE 0x6810, LDTR_BASE 0x6812, TR_BASE 0x6814, GDTR_BASE 0x6816, IDTR_BASE 0x6818, DR7 0x681a, RSP 0x681c, RIP 0x681e, RFLAGS 0x6820, PENDING_DBG_EXCEPTIONS 0x6822, SYSENTER_ESP 0x6824, SYSENTER_EIP 0x6826, S_CET 0x6828, SSP 0x682a, INTR_SSP_TABLE 0x682c.

Wide host-state identifiers use these encodings: CR0 0x6c00, CR3 0x6c02, CR4 0x6c04, FS_BASE 0x6c06, GS_BASE 0x6c08, TR_BASE 0x6c0a, GDTR_BASE 0x6c0c, IDTR_BASE 0x6c0e, SYSENTER_ESP 0x6c10, SYSENTER_EIP 0x6c12, RSP 0x6c14, RIP 0x6c16, S_CET 0x6c18, SSP 0x6c1a, INTR_SSP_TABLE 0x6c1c.

Interrupt-information word layout: vector occupies bits 7:0 with mask 0xff, type occupies bits 10:8 with mask 0x700, deliver-error-code is bit 11 with mask 0x800, unblock-NMI is bit 12 with value 0x1000, valid is bit 31 with mask 0x80000000, reserved bits carry mask 0x7ffff000. Vectoring-info vector/type/deliver/valid masks alias the interrupt-info masks. Interrupt-type encodings are formed by shifting an event-type selector left by 8 for external, reserved, NMI, hard exception, soft interrupt, privileged software exception, soft exception and other event.

Guest interruptibility flags are single bits: STI is 1, MOV_SS blocking is 2, SMI blocking is 4, NMI blocking is 8, enclave-interrupt blocking is 0x10. Guest activity codes are ACTIVE 0, HLT 1, SHUTDOWN 2, WAIT_SIPI 3.

Guest activity occupies exactly one of four states: active execution, halted, shutdown, or waiting for startup IPI. Transitions among them are driven by guest execution and events outside these fragments; the fragments only fix the four code values and their distinct meanings.

Control-register exit detail layout: register number uses mask 0x7 for bits 2:0, access type uses mask 0x30 for bits 5:4, general register selector uses mask 0xf00 for bits 10:8. LMSW source data occupies the high half with shift 16 and mask 0xFFFF shifted by 16. General-register selectors encode EAX/ECX/EDX/EBX/ESP/EBP/ESI/EDI/R8-R15 as index 0-15 shifted left by 8.

Debug-register exit detail layout: register number uses mask 0x7, direction uses mask 0x10 with to-debug-register as 0 shifted by 4 and from-debug-register as 1 shifted by 4, general register is recovered by shifting right 8 and masking 0xf. APIC exit detail layout: page offset uses mask 0xfff, access type uses mask 0xf000; type codes are linear read 0, linear write 1, linear fetch 2, linear event 3, physical event 10, physical instruction 15, each shifted left by 12.

Segment access-right word layout: type-accessed bit is 1, readable bit is 2, writable bit is 4, code bit is 8, full type mask is 0xf; busy 64-bit and 32-bit TSS type is 11, busy 16-bit TSS type is 3, LDT type is 2; system bit is 0x10, present bit is 0x80, long bit is 1 shifted by 13, default/big bit is 1 shifted by 14, granularity bit is 1 shifted by 15, unusable bit is 1 shifted by 16; privilege level is bits 6:5 with shift 5 and mask 3; reserved mask is 0xfffe0f00.

Private memory slots are offsets from the user-slot base: task-state slot is base plus 0, APIC-access slot is base plus 1, identity-pagetable slot is base plus 2. VPID space holds 1 shifted by 16 identifiers. VPID invalidation extents are individual-address 0, single-context 1, all-contexts 2, single-non-global 3. EPT invalidation extents are context 1 and global 2 with an encoding shift of 24.

EPT and VPID capability bits are single 64-bit flags: execute-only bit 0, 4-level walk bit 6, 5-level walk bit 7, uncacheable EPTP bit 8, writeback EPTP bit 14, 2MB page bit 16, 1GB page bit 17, INVEPT bit 20, accessed-dirty bit 21, advanced exit-info bit 22, context extent bit 25, global extent bit 26; INVVPID bit 0 and VPID extent bits 8/9/10/11. EPTP page-walk field uses mask 0x38 with 4-level code 0x18 and 5-level code 0x20; EPT entry memory-type shift is 3 and EPTP accessed-dirty enable is bit 6.

EPT permission and type bits: readable is bit 0, writable bit 1, executable bit 2, combined read-write-execute mask is their union, user-executable is bit 10, ignore-PAT is bit 6, accessed is bit 8, dirty is bit 9, suppress-VE is bit 63, entry memory-type mask is 7 shifted by 3. EPTP memory-type mask is 7 with writeback and uncacheable selectors. A write-plus-execute combination without read denotes misconfiguration. The identity pagetable address is 0xfffbc000.
MSR save-restore entry layout is a 16-byte aligned record holding a 32-bit MSR index, then a 32-bit reserved word, then a 64-bit value, in that order.

Virtualization-exception information layout is an ordered record holding a 32-bit exit reason, a 32-bit delivery field, a 64-bit exit qualification, a 64-bit guest linear address, a 64-bit guest physical address, and a 16-bit EPTP index, in that order.

A page-walk-level helper accepts an EPT pointer value, isolates its page-walk-length field, reports five levels when the field matches the five-level code, and otherwise reports four levels. The caller is responsible for supplying an already validated pointer.
The page-walk decoder treats only the five-level code as five, treats the four-level code as the expected fallback, and raises a one-time warning for any other encoding while still returning four.
The examined headers expose an inline EPTP page-walk decoder plus two record layouts for MSR entries and virtualization-exception information for use by virtualization code.

Entry-failure codes are default 0, PDPTE 2, NMI 3, VMCS link pointer 4. Instruction-error numbers are the listed values 1-13, 15-20 and 22-26 plus 28 with the stated gaps. The vmentry diagnostic subset covers non-clear launch, non-launched resume, resume after VMXOFF, invalid control field, invalid host-state field, and MOV_SS event blocking. L1D-flush policy lists six selectors in order: auto, never, conditional, always, EPT-disabled, not-required.

L1D-flush policy occupies one selector among automatic choice, never flush, conditional flush, always flush, EPT-disabled handling, and flush-not-required. Selection is made by higher-level policy outside these fragments; the fragments only fix the available selectors.

EPT-violation detail bits are single flags: access read/write/instruction are bits 0/1/2, protection read/write/execute/user-execute are bits 3/4/5/6 with a combined protection mask, guest-address valid/translated/user/writable/not-executable are bits 7/8/9/10/11. Entry permission bits convert to protection bits by shifting the read-write-execute group left by 3 and by shifting the user-executable bit right by 4.
Notification exit qualification reports an invalid VM context with bit 0.
The VMX feature header is guarded by its include macro and reports capability as five 32-bit words. Feature selectors are expressed as word index times 32 plus bit offset.

Word-zero VMX capability selectors are interrupt-exiting bit 0, NMI-exiting bit 3, virtual NMIs bit 5, preemption timer bit 6, posted interrupts bit 7, INVVPID bit 16, EPT execute-only bit 17, EPT accessed-dirty bit 18, EPT 1GB bit 19, EPT 5-level bit 20, flexpriority bit 24, APIC virtualization bit 25, EPTP switching bit 28.

Word-one VMX capability selectors are interrupt-window exiting bit 2, TSC offsetting bit 3, HLT exiting bit 7, INVLPG exiting bit 9, MWAIT exiting bit 10, RDPMC exiting bit 11, RDTSC exiting bit 12, CR3-load exiting bit 15, CR3-store exiting bit 16, tertiary controls bit 17, CR8-load exiting bit 19, CR8-store exiting bit 20, virtual TPR bit 21, NMI-window exiting bit 22, MOV-DR exiting bit 23, unconditional IO exiting bit 24, IO bitmaps bit 25, monitor trap flag bit 27, MSR bitmaps bit 28, MONITOR exiting bit 29, PAUSE exiting bit 30, secondary controls bit 31.

Reserved-bit masks for interrupt information and segment access rights must not be treated as meaningful state. The page-walk decoder must not be called with unvalidated pointers since unexpected encodings only warn and fall back to four levels. Write-plus-execute without read in EPT entries denotes a misconfiguration rather than a grantable permission.
